app.title: Browser automation
app.subtitle: AUTOMATION PORTAL
app.footer_note: M4 management portal · local use only
scenes.new_notice: Creating a scenario makes a v1 draft with a single step that opens a page. Change it into the real steps on the edit page.
scenes.new_id: Scenario ID (lowercase letters, digits, - or _; it cannot be changed or reused)
revision.id_mismatch: The id in the scenario file must be {id} (scenario IDs cannot change)
revision.extra_file: {path} is not used by this scenario
revision.no_scenario: The scenario file scenario.yaml is missing
scene.not_published: Nothing is published yet: validate a revision, publish it once it passes, then run it.
scene.newer_draft: Runs use the published v{published}; v{latest} is used only after it passes validation and is published.
scene.versions_hint: Revisions are immutable; editing creates a new revision
scene.base_url_hint: Prefilled when validating and running. Leave empty to use the baseUrl in the scenario file ({default}).
spec.name: Name
edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.older: This is the older v{shown}. Saving creates a new revision with this content (the latest is v{latest}).
edit.notice: The files are validated before saving; nothing is saved if there are problems. A new revision must pass validation before it can be published.
edit.note_placeholder: For example: use the new submit button
run_form.description_validation: Runs v{number} in a real browser; once it passes, this revision can be published.
run_form.notice_validation: Validation really operates the target site, including steps with side effects such as creating records. Use a test environment or test data.
run_form.notice_execution: Operates the target site with the published revision. Steps with side effects are never retried automatically.
run_form.inputs_hint: Defaults are filled in; inputs without a default must be filled in. They are checked first, and the browser is not started if any input is invalid.
run_form.window_hint: Headed mode opens a browser window on the computer running the Portal, so you can watch every step; headless mode runs in the background without disturbing whoever is using the computer.
run_form.window_unavailable: The computer running the Portal has no graphical desktop (for example a Linux server without DISPLAY), so only headless mode is available.
run_form.base_url_hint: Overrides the baseUrl in the scenario file. Leave empty to use the scenario file.
runs.description: Filter by category, scenario and result. Every run keeps its inputs, outputs, steps, assertions and screenshots.
run.title: Run {id}
run.polling: Running; this page updates when the status changes.
run.newer_validation: The latest validation of this revision did not pass, so this result cannot be used to publish it. Validate it again.
run.interrupted: The server restarted and interrupted this run; run it again
run.hash_mismatch: The content that ran does not match the revision hash, so this validation does not count
run.scenario_invalid: The scenario file has {count} problem(s) and cannot run
run.crashed: The run failed with an error: {detail}
error.revision_unreadable: The files of scenario {id} v{number} are missing or no longer valid
error.scene_id_invalid: Invalid scenario ID "{id}": start with a lowercase letter or digit and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (at most 64)
error.revision_invalid: {count} problem(s) found; no revision was created
error.scene_exists: The scenario ID {id} is already used (including archived scenarios); choose another
error.revision_conflict: Someone just saved a new revision of {id}; reload and edit again
error.stale_base: You started from v{base}, but the latest is now v{latest}. Reload and edit the latest revision
error.no_examples: The examples folder was not found (RPA_EXAMPLES_DIR)
error.inputs_invalid: {count} input problem(s); the run was not started
error.not_validated: Scenario {id} v{number} has not passed validation and cannot be published
error.content_changed: The files of scenario {id} v{number} differ from what was validated; it cannot be published
error.file_not_found: {path} is not in the run folder
error.base_url_invalid: The URL must start with http or https: {value}
error_page.title: Something went wrong
placeholder.playground_description: Chain published scenarios so that each one's outputs become the next one's inputs.
placeholder.playground_plan: In M6 this page arranges scenario sequences with pinned revisions, output bindings and stop-on-failure. Until then, copy the outputs of one run into the inputs of the next scenario by hand.
server.sqlite_notice: Using SQLite: for development and prototypes only. Set RPA_DATABASE_URL to PostgreSQL in production
server.recovered: {count} run(s) were interrupted when the server stopped and are marked as failed
template.comment: New scenario: change browser.baseUrl and steps into the real actions, save a new revision, then validate it. See docs/design/dsl.html
js.save_failed: That did not work; try again
js.publish_body: After publishing, runs use this revision; earlier published revisions stay in the history. Publish it?
js.cancel_body: The browser stops right away. Actions already completed on the target site are not undone.
js.stale_base: Someone saved a newer revision; reload and edit again
js.json_invalid: The inputs must be a JSON object (names and values inside curly braces)
domain.testsite_description: Real cases that run against the local test site (started with rpa serve at http://127.0.0.1:8765): create a record, look it up, look up a record that does not exist, and the Python script version of creating a record.
domain.empty: No scenarios in this domain yet. Create one, or move a scenario here from its Run settings.
card.debug_title: Validate the latest v{number}: it really operates the target site and can be published once it passes
domains.description: Group scenarios by target system or business area, for example Google automation or Microsoft automation. Each domain is an item in the Scenarios side menu.
domains.unassigned_hint: Choose a domain in the scenario's Run settings
domains.new_notice: For example: ID google, name “Google automation”. The ID is used in addresses and cannot be changed later.
error.domain_id_invalid: Invalid domain ID "{id}": start with a lowercase letter or digit and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (at most 64)
error.domain_exists: The domain ID {id} is already used; choose another
error.domain_not_empty: Domain {id} still has {count} scenario(s), including archived ones; move them to another domain first
error.display_unavailable: The computer running the Portal has no graphical desktop, so it cannot show a browser window; use headless mode instead.
js.domain_delete_body: The domain will disappear from the side menu. Delete it?
roles.description: Register how each test account logs in and how to tell it is logged in; scenarios use it with login: {{ role: … }}. Each role keeps its own login state, never shared.
roles.notice: Before a run, the role's login is checked; if it is not logged in the run stops at "Login required" without running any step. "Log in" opens a browser window on the computer running the Portal so you can log in yourself (SSO, captchas and two-factor all work); the login state is stored only in this computer's data folder, readable only by you.
roles.no_display: The computer running the Portal has no display, so a browser window for manual login cannot be opened; you can give the role automatic login steps instead.
roles.empty: No login roles yet. Add a role here when a scenario needs to log in.
roles.session_waiting: A browser window is open on the computer running the Portal: log in there, then press "Finish login" or simply close the window.
roles.login_title: Open a browser window on the Portal's computer and log in yourself
roles.check_title: Check in a headless browser whether the login is still valid (logs in automatically when automatic login steps exist)
roles.form_notice: For example: id erp-clerk, name "ERP clerk". The id goes into a scenario's login.role and cannot be changed later.
roles.form_description: Description (optional, e.g. which test account; never a password)
roles.form_check_url_placeholder: A page only visible when logged in; empty means the login URL
roles.form_check: Element visible only when logged in (DSL locator)
roles.form_check_hint: e.g. {{ testId: current-user }}, {{ role: button, name: Log out }}, {{ text: My account }}.
roles.form_auto: Automatic login steps (optional, a list of DSL steps)
roles.form_auto_hint: Only for plain username/password systems; use {{{{ secrets.NAME }}}} for the password and set its value under Secrets below. Leave empty for manual login only.
secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.hint: Values stay on this computer and are never shown by pages or the API
secrets.empty: No secrets yet, and no scenario or role uses one.
secrets.form_notice: The value is stored in secrets.json in the data folder, readable only by you; it is never shown again.
needs.title: Before running
recording.description: Record on this computer or paste a codegen recording → DSL draft → step debugging → validation → publish by hand. Recordings are never published directly.
recording.active: Recording {scene}: the browser window and Playwright Inspector are open on the computer running the Portal; close the browser window when you are done.
recording.in_progress: Recording: use the browser on the computer running the Portal and close its window when you are done; the draft appears here automatically.
recording.record_hint: After "Start recording", a browser and the Playwright Inspector open on the computer running the Portal; work as usual and close the browser window when done. Typed values become inputs and password fields become secrets.
recording.paste_hint: Paste the Python generated by Playwright codegen (for example recorded elsewhere with rpa record) to convert it into a draft.
recording.no_display: The computer running the Portal has no display, so it cannot record here; record with rpa record on a computer with a desktop and paste the recording.
recording.target_existing: A new revision of a scenario
recording.existing_hint: The result replaces the scenario's steps as a new draft revision (older revisions are kept).
recording.url_paste_hint: Optional: used as the first step when the recording opens no URL.
recording.cli_hint: You can also record from the command line:
recording.detail_description: The recording and the {scene} draft converted from it.
recording.done_notice: Saved as draft v{number} of {scene}. Next: debug step by step to make sure every element is found, then validate and publish.
recording.raw_hint: Passwords masked; kept as the source, never published
recording.nothing_recorded: Nothing was recorded (the browser may not have opened).
recording.no_actions: No actions were recorded (only the URL was opened); no revision was created.
recording.interrupted: The server restarted and the recording was interrupted; please record again
role.auto_logged_in: Was not logged in; logged in automatically
role.login_done: Logged in; the login state was updated
role.login_ended: The browser ended unexpectedly (exit code {code}); no login state was saved
role.login_not_confirmed: The login did not succeed and the state was not updated; please try again
role.login_timeout: The login took too long; the browser was closed
debug.title: Debug {name}
debug.description: Run one step at a time in a browser, see the page after each step, test locators, and edit the YAML into a new revision.
debug.start_notice: Debugging really operates the target site. Steps with side effects (click, fill, select, check, press) ask for confirmation before running again; no step is ever repeated automatically.
debug.window_hint: Headed mode opens a browser window on the computer running the Portal; both modes show a screenshot after every step on this page.
debug.starting: Starting the browser… (the first Firefox start can take a dozen seconds)
debug.idle_closed: Closed after being idle too long
debug.session_notice: Debugging v{revision} · {engine} · {window}. Closes automatically after {minutes} idle minutes.
debug.no_screenshot: No screenshot yet: run a step or press "Screenshot".
debug.found: Found {count} element(s) (outlined in red in the screenshot)
debug.yaml_hint: Saving creates a new revision and keeps debugging with it; steps that ran are kept by id
debug.save: Save as a new revision and keep debugging
contract.title: Edit inputs and outputs
contract.notice: Saving rewrites only the inputs and outputs sections of the scenario file, keeping everything else (including comments), and creates a new revision (to be validated again). Renaming an input also renames its references in the steps.
contract.script_notice: This is a Python script scenario: outputs come from assertion.py, and renaming an input does not change the scripts.
contract.note_placeholder: e.g. raise the quantity limit to 50
run.rerun_title: Run again with the same inputs and options
run.needs_login_hint: After logging in, press "Run again" to repeat the run with the same inputs.
error.role_id_invalid: Role id "{id}" is invalid: it must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
error.role_url_invalid: The URL must start with http or https: {value}
error.role_check_invalid: "Element visible when logged in" is not a valid locator: {detail}
error.role_steps_invalid: The automatic login steps have {count} problem(s)
error.role_steps_not_list: Automatic login steps must be a list of DSL steps (each starting with -)
error.role_in_use: Role {id} is still used by {scenes} and cannot be deleted
error.role_busy: Role {id} is logging in or being checked; please wait
error.login_display_unavailable: The computer running the Portal has no display, so a browser window for manual login cannot be opened; give the role automatic login steps or run the Portal on a computer with a desktop.
error.login_not_active: Role {id} has no login in progress
error.login_not_waiting: The browser window for role {id} is not ready yet; please wait and try again
error.secret_name_invalid: Secret name "{name}" is invalid: it must start with an uppercase letter and contain only uppercase letters, digits and _
error.record_display_unavailable: The computer running the Portal has no display, so it cannot record; record with rpa record on a computer with a desktop and paste the recording.
error.recording_url_invalid: The start URL must start with http or https: {value}
error.recording_active: A recording is already in progress; finish or cancel it first
error.debug_not_found: Debug session {id} was not found (it may have ended)
error.debug_script: Python script scenarios cannot be debugged step by step; use a validation run
error.debug_starting: The browser is still starting; please wait
error.debug_busy: The previous command is still running; please wait
error.debug_confirm: Step {number} ({id}) has side effects and has already run; run it again?
error.debug_already_executed: Steps up to {number} have already run; use "Run this step" or "Start over" to run them again
error.contract_name_missing: Every input and output needs a name
js.role_delete_body: The role and its login state will be deleted. Are you sure?
js.role_clear_body: The role's login state on this computer is deleted; runs stop at "Login required" until you log in again.
js.secret_delete_body: Scenarios and roles that use it will fail for a missing secret (unless an environment variable with the same name exists). Are you sure?
js.recording_started: Recording started: use the browser on the computer running the Portal
js.debug_close_body: The debugging browser is closed; actions already done on the target site are not undone.
role.secret_missing: Not logged in; automatic login needs secrets that are not set: {names}
